message.content: Start this Bash command IN THE BACKGROUND (run_in_background: true): python3 -c "import time; time.sleep(15); print('BG-done')" . Do not wait for it. Immediately end your turn by saying STARTED. Later, when you are notified that the background command finished, write the single word it printed into a new file bg.md in the current folder with the Write tool, then reply with one word: WRITTEN

updatedInput.description: Run 15-second background sleep that prints BG-done
